name: fmi-fingrid-nowcast
title: FMI Weather + Fingrid Wind/Solar Nowcast Feed (Finland)
description: Hourly joined nowcast feature feed combining Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI) hub weather forecasts with Fingrid wind, solar & consumption forecasts and actuals for energy traders and EV-charging firms. Dual CC BY 4.0 attribution. No exchange prices.

hourStartUtc.title: Hour start (UTC)
hourStartUtc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp for the hour.

fmiWindSpeedWeightedMs.title: FMI wind-hub wind speed (m/s)
fmiWindSpeedWeightedMs.description: Wind-capacity-weighted hub wind speed in m/s.

fmiTempDemandWeightedC.title: FMI demand-hub temperature (°C)
fmiTempDemandWeightedC.description: Demand-weighted temperature across Finnish hubs in °C.

residualLoadMW.title: Residual load (MW)
residualLoadMW.description: Consumption forecast minus wind and solar forecasts (MW).

renewableSharePct.title: Wind+solar share (%)
renewableSharePct.description: Share of forecasted consumption covered by wind + solar (%).

windRamp1hMW.title: 1h wind ramp (MW)
windRamp1hMW.description: Hour-over-hour change in wind power forecast (MW).

rank.title: Residual load rank
rank.description: 1 = lowest residual load hour in window.

isEvChargeRecommended.title: EV charge recommended
isEvChargeRecommended.description: True if hour is in topN lowest residual load hours without storm cut-out risk.

attribution.title: Dual CC BY 4.0 attribution
attribution.description: Mandatory Fingrid + FMI CC BY 4.0 attribution.
